cut: Coxon, Per Caller, DRAFT v1 (20 Oct) — one question: can an AI call your cellphone about the election without asking? | v2 21 Oct: US in the question and the consent line (owner: 'same notes as Wednesday') | v3 22 Oct: the ruling line updated (an FCC spokesperson told Reuters on 19 Oct the agency has no plans to act on the petition)
argument: Not today: a political group has asked the FCC to let AI-voiced political calls reach cellphones without consent. The FCC says it has no plans to act before Election Day, and the proposed limit is three a month per caller.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Can an AI call your cellphone / about the US election / [without asking]?
text.fi: Saako tekoäly soittaa / kännykkääsi USA:n vaaleista / [kysymättä]?
text.ja: AIは あなたの 携帯に / 米国の 選挙の 電話を / [断りなく] かけられる？

captions.source: The film's question. Today's rule: FCC declaratory ruling FCC 24-17 (Feb 2024). The request: Club for Growth's petition of 31 Aug 2026, FCC Public Notice DA 26-940, CG Docket 02-278 (re-checked 20 Oct, plan/films/16-per-caller.md).

text.en: Today, US rules say: / only with your [consent].
text.ja: 米国の 今の ルールでは / あなたの [同意] が 必要。

captions.source: FCC 24-17 (Feb 2024): AI-generated voices are 'artificial' voices under the TCPA, so robocalls using them to cellphones need prior express consent unless an exemption applies (PBS NewsHour, Feb 2024; restated in every report on the petition, e.g. TheTelephony, Oct 2026).

text.en: A political group has [asked] / the FCC to drop that rule / for political calls.
text.fi: Poliittinen ryhmä on [pyytänyt] / FCC:tä poistamaan säännön / poliittisilta puheluilta.
text.ja: ある 政治団体が FCCに / 政治の 電話では その ルールを / 外すよう [求めた]。

captions.source: Club for Growth petition, filed 31 Aug 2026: a waiver of 47 CFR 64.1200(a)(1)(iii) and an exemption from 47 USC 227(b)(1)(A)(iii) so noncommercial political calls with an artificial or prerecorded voice, including an AI voice, can reach wireless numbers without prior express consent; industry-wide. FCC CGB Public Notice DA 26-940, 4 Sep 2026. AP, 7 Oct 2026. The group is not named on screen.

text.en: Comments closed 19 October. / The FCC says it has no plans / to act [before Election Day].
text.fi: Lausuntoaika päättyi 19.10. / FCC:n mukaan päätöstä ei ole / tulossa [ennen vaalipäivää].
text.ja: 意見募集は 10月19日に 締め切り。 / FCCに よると [投票日の 前に] / 判断する 予定は ない。

captions.source: DA 26-940: comments due 5 Oct, replies due 19 Oct 2026 (ITIF's reply comments dated 19 Oct; NCLC's opposition 5 Oct). Reuters (David Shepardson), 19 Oct 2026: an FCC spokesperson said no one at the agency has expressed interest in moving to an order on this or any of the petitions, and there are no plans to do so; Commissioner Gomez had said the agency could act within days. The film says the narrower, still-true 'no plans to act before Election Day' and quotes no one. Re-checked 22 Oct (search summaries; no ruling found).

text.en: The proposed limit: / three AI calls a month. / [Per caller].
text.fi: Ehdotettu raja: / kolme tekoälypuhelua kuussa. / [Soittajaa kohden].
text.ja: 提案された 上限は / 月に 3回の AI電話。 / [発信者 ごとに]。

captions.source: The petition's own condition: no more than three calls from the same caller to a line in any 30-day period ('a month' rounds the 30 days), with an automated opt-out and a company-specific do-not-call list (TheTelephony; Techlicious; DA 26-940 as summarised). The queue is the plain arithmetic of 'from the same caller', drawn as such; it claims nothing about any group's intent.

form.en: I agree to receive calls / made with an AI voice / on my cellphone. · SIGNATURE · DATE
form.why: the consent form's small print, under its translated heading: English in every master, the caption carries it

petition.en: PETITION · FOR A WAIVER · NO CONSENT NEEDED · FOR POLITICAL CALLS · TO CELLPHONES · AI AND RECORDED VOICES · MAX. 3 CALLS / 30 DAYS · per caller
petition.why: the petition as a document: its terms, in the FCC's language; the punchline's 'per caller' is already in its small print

plate.why: the desk's brass plate: the body, named (a label, not a seal or a logo)

calendar.en: OCTOBER 2026 · NOVEMBER 2026 · S M T W T F S
calendar.why: a US wall calendar, so the week starts on Sunday and 3 November is a Tuesday

cards.why: every call card says which of its caller's three it is: the arithmetic of 'per caller'

post.en: In the US, an AI-voiced robocall to your cellphone needs your consent. A political group asked the FCC to drop that for political calls. The FCC says it has no plans to act on it before Election Day. The proposed limit: three calls a month, per caller. #AI #FCC #robocalls
post.fi: Nyt tekoälyäänellä soitettu robottipuhelu kännykkään vaatii suostumuksesi. Poliittinen ryhmä on pyytänyt FCC:tä poistamaan säännön poliittisilta puheluilta. FCC:n mukaan päätöstä ei ole tulossa ennen vaalipäivää. Ehdotettu raja: kolme puhelua kuussa, soittajaa kohden.
post.ja: 今のルールでは、AI音声の自動電話を携帯にかけるにはあなたの同意が必要。ある政治団体がFCCに、政治の電話ではそのルールを外すよう求めた。FCCによると、投票日の前に判断する予定はない。提案された上限は月3回。ただし発信者ごとに。
